question: Which zoo are situated within 140 kilometers following the west direction from Rock of the Marne, VA?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.073797 38.876769)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.073797 38.876769)',4326)::geography, 140000)
AND tourism = 'zoo'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5;

answers.poi_name: Heavenly Heart Farm & Mini Petting Zoo
answers.description: Traveling petting zoo, open on location for special events or by appointment. Contact via email or phone for details.
